svg.title: A bounded owned-shard loop and a lazy array dependency graph
svg.desc: The implemented bounded executor reserves at most two whole-shard tasks. Inside one task, the serialized source read, preparation and selected solve repeat for bounded blocks until its all-channel output buffer is complete. The worker returns that buffer; the coordinator writes the owned shard once. The conceptual Dask alternative exposes source chunks, map_blocks calculations, output alignment and to_zarr dependencies. Four pictured chunk tasks are illustrative, and graph optimization may fuse operations. Both formulations produce a full-resolution array before application-owned spatial pyramid reduction and metadata completion. The figure makes no performance comparison.
